planning.note: Byte/storage figures are engineering assumptions until an approved retrieval measures actual bytes. Historical row scale is unknown.

hard_stop_rules.history: If full history has no deterministic finite stopping rule, redesign to bounded history or snapshots; never implement an unbounded crawler.
hard_stop_rules.redistribution: If redistribution is prohibited, do not publish raw Kaggle data; redesign to code/provenance/fetch-from-source or separately approved aggregates.
hard_stop_rules.identity: If longitudinal identity is not defensible, redesign to permit/facility/episode or snapshot grain.
hard_stop_rules.lifecycle: If terminal states or event timing are not defensible, do not create survival labels; use status-only, interval-censored, or snapshot analyses.
hard_stop_rules.crs: If coordinate fields or CRS cannot be authoritatively tied together, do not transform or publish longitude/latitude.
